questions.subject: FILM_STUDIES
questions.learningObjective: Define and distinguish key film studies concepts
questions.stem: Which statement best defines Animation?

options.text: It is the technique of creating moving images from a sequence of individual frames.
It is a technique where drawings are painted onto transparent celluloid sheets.
It is a technique photographing physical objects frame by frame as they are moved.
It is the tracing of live-action footage frame by frame to create animation.

questions.explanation: It is the technique of creating moving images from a sequence of individual frames. This is precisely what Animation means; the alternatives describe Cel animation, Stop motion, Rotoscoping, which are different ideas.
questions.hint: Recall the specific meaning of Animation.
